# Ready Set Ink

> Free Disney Lorcana card search and deck builder. Search all 2,653 cards across 19 sets by what they do or by what is in the artwork, build and legality-check decks, look up official rulings, and track a collection. No account needed. Unofficial fan site, not published, endorsed or approved by Disney or Ravensburger.

Prefer the raw data files below over scraping HTML. They are static JSON, free to fetch, and updated whenever the site is rebuilt. Please cite https://www.readysetink.com when you use them.

## Raw data (best for agents)

- [Card database](https://www.readysetink.com/card-db.json): every card as JSON. Top-level keys: `fetched`, `priced`, `sets`, `cards`. Each card has `n` name, `v` version, `c` cost, `ik` inkable, `co` ink colors, `ty` type, `sub` subtypes, `tx` rules text, `ef` effect text, `kw` keywords, `st` strength, `wi` willpower, `lo` lore, `r` rarity, `s` set number, `num` collector number, `sto` source story, `ar` artists, `fl` flavor text, `p` / `pf` USD price (regular / foil).
- [Official rulings](https://www.readysetink.com/card-rules.json): rulings from Ravensburger's set release notes, keyed by exact card name.
- [Meta decks](https://www.readysetink.com/meta-decks.json): competitive deck lists grouped by point in a set's life.
- [Prices](https://www.readysetink.com/card-prices.json): USD snapshot per printing, dated 2026-10-01. A rough guide, not a live quote.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.readysetink.com/): card search and the full app.
- [Glossary](https://www.readysetink.com/glossary/): over 120 Lorcana terms in plain English - rules vocabulary, all 14 keyword abilities with rule numbers, formats, community slang and collecting words. Also as [markdown](https://www.readysetink.com/glossary.md) and [JSON](https://www.readysetink.com/glossary.json).
- [Keywords](https://www.readysetink.com/keywords/): all 14 keyword abilities, one page each at `https://www.readysetink.com/keywords/<keyword>/` with the rule in plain English and every card that has it.
- [Sets](https://www.readysetink.com/sets/): one page per set at `https://www.readysetink.com/sets/<set>/` with the cards first printed in it. Reprints appear under their original set.
- [Franchises](https://www.readysetink.com/franchises/): cards grouped by Disney story, one page each at `https://www.readysetink.com/franchises/<franchise>/`.
- [Characters](https://www.readysetink.com/characters/): every version of each character with more than one card, at `https://www.readysetink.com/characters/<character>/`.
- [Card index](https://www.readysetink.com/card/): every card, one static page each at `https://www.readysetink.com/card/<card-name>.html`, with text, stats, rulings and prices.
- [Deck builder](https://www.readysetink.com/deck-builder/): build and share Lorcana decks with live legality checking, pull sheets and goldfishing.
- [Search](https://www.readysetink.com/search/): search by rules text, cost, color, or artwork content.
- [Meta decks](https://www.readysetink.com/meta-decks/): what is winning right now.
- [Collection](https://www.readysetink.com/collection/): track which cards you own.
- [Games](https://www.readysetink.com/games/): Lorcana guessing games.
- [Lore tracker](https://www.readysetink.com/loretracker/): a free lore counter for in-person play.

## Markdown versions

Append `.md` to any card, keyword, set, franchise or character URL for a compact plain-markdown version, for example `https://www.readysetink.com/card/elsa-snow-queen.md` and `https://www.readysetink.com/keywords/shift.md`. Also: `https://www.readysetink.com/glossary.md`, `https://www.readysetink.com/keywords.md`, `https://www.readysetink.com/sets.md`, `https://www.readysetink.com/franchises.md`, `https://www.readysetink.com/characters.md`.

## Sitemap

- [sitemap.xml](https://www.readysetink.com/sitemap.xml): every page, 2,653 card pages included.
